name: docs-page-footer
title: Docs page footer
description: The end of every docs page: an edit link, when it changed and who wrote it, a feedback slot, and previous and next cards that say where each goes.
docs: Pass editHref (where the page can be edited; it opens in a new tab and says so), updated ({ label, dateTime }: the label is the words, formatted on your side in the language and time zone of the page, and dateTime the same day for the time element), contributors ({ name, image }: up to four avatars with the total written beside them, and every name in a list only a screen reader gets), a feedback slot (keep its buttons in the page after a choice, as the demo does, so keyboard focus is not dropped), and previous and next ({ href, title }). The cards keep their direction words on screen ("Previous guide", "Next guide", from noun), so a screen reader hears them with the title; a missing side leaves its half empty, so the other card stays on the right. linkAs renders the cards with your router's Link, and labels translates the fixed words. No state of its own, so it renders on the server.
